in_marathi.name: Shveta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे White, pure, radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shveta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'shwetas', meaning white, pure, radiant. In Hindu mythology, Shveta is associated with the goddess Saraswati, symbolizing knowledge, learning, and wisdom. It is also a common name for newborn girls in India.
